clips.tags: Calm, low-energy tutorial underscore; soft felt piano playing sparse, measured phrases over warm, dark ambient pads; faint distant bell tones used very sparingly; steady gentle pulse without percussion; keep the arrangement even and unobtrusive beneath voiceover, with no build or dramatic peak, and end on a loop-friendly sustained harmony.
